name: DJ Fresh
description:
'''Daniel Edward Stein''' (born 11 April 1977), known professionally as '''DJ Fresh''', is an English DJ and record producer. A member of the [[drum and bass]] group [[Bad Company (drum and bass group)|Bad Company]], he co-founded the music website [[Dogs on Acid]] and, with [[Adam F]], the record label [[Breakbeat Kaos]]. His singles "[[Louder (DJ Fresh song)|Louder]]", featuring [[Sian Evans]], and "[[Hot Right Now]]", featuring [[Rita Ora]], became the first [[dubstep]] and drum and bass tracks, respectively, to reach number one on the [[UK Singles Chart]]. Stein retrained as a software engineer, subsequently worked in machine learning and co-founded Voice-Swap, an AI voice-modelling company that licenses singers' voices and pays royalties to participating artists.

He has released three studio albums and achieved eight UK top-ten singles, including six top-five hits and two number ones. His single "[[Gold Dust (DJ Fresh song)|Gold Dust]]" was certified triple platinum in the United Kingdom by the [[British Phonographic Industry]] in 2024.
